businesses.business: smart mobility technology and traffic enforcement

offering_description.value: Provides automated tolling, violation management and photo enforcement (speed and red-light cameras) technology and services. Serves rental car companies, fleet owners, vehicle manufacturers, toll authorities and government agencies, delivering through proprietary software platforms, cameras and back-office processing.

primary_products.value: photo enforcement cameras; tolling and violation management software; vehicle title and registration platforms

primary_services.value: electronic toll and violation management for fleets; camera-based speed and red-light enforcement programs; citation processing; vehicle registration and title services

customer_segment.value: B2B: rental car companies, fleet managers, automakers, toll operators; B2G: municipalities, school districts, transportation agencies, law enforcement; B2C: consumers using violation payment and toll-related services

end_markets.value: car rental; fleet management; automotive; road tolling; municipal traffic safety

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: per-transaction fees for tolls and violations processed for fleets; service fees: fees from governments per citation or per camera program operated; subscription: recurring fees for fleet tolling and compliance platforms
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: tolling, violation and registration platforms for fleets, OEMs and agencies; service provider: operates enforcement camera programs and processes citations for municipalities; asset operator: owns and operates installed enforcement cameras for government clients
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; service provider; asset operator

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Europe, Canada and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: commercial services tolling, government solutions enforcement, and parking solutions

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales to rental companies, fleets, automakers and government agencies; online: web portals for consumers and fleets to pay tolls and violations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: traffic enforcement camera laws, state and local rules, data privacy and toll authority requirements
